2609.18128.title: Symbolic Temporal Supervision of LLM Agents Using Contracts
2609.18128.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents augmented by tools can automate complex, multi-step tasks, such as web navigation, code generation, and workflow orchestration, by acting on external systems through tool calls. However, hallucinations, distributional instability, and adversarial manipulations in LLMs, and the irreversible consequences of certain tool calls can lead to harmful outcomes. Existing safeguards either grade recorded trajectories post hoc with stochastic LLM judges or block unsafe actions one call at a time, and no single deterministic artifact supports both roles. We present ContrAgent, a contract-based framework for symbolic temporal supervision of LLM agents. ContrAgent captures an agent's behavior as a sequence of tool calls and formalizes it as a trace over a fixed set of checkable predicates. It then specifies required behaviors using assume-guarantee contracts in linear temporal logic over finite traces (LTLf). Each contract is compiled to a deterministic finite automaton (DFA) that serves two roles: gating agent actions online and evaluating recorded traces offline. A contract library, acting as a reusable knowledge base, is maintained independently of the agent's model and can be applied across different agents within the same task domain. We show the effectiveness of our approach on four benchmarks spanning both roles, where ContrAgent matches state-of-the-art LLM-judge and rule-based guardrail baselines while producing deterministic, reproducible verdicts and, in the online mode, orders-of-magnitude lower per-call latency.
2609.18128.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理透過工具增強，可以自動化複雜的多步驟任務，例如網頁導航、代碼生成和工作流程協調，通過工具調用對外部系統進行操作。<lb/>然而，LLM中的幻覺、分佈不穩定性和對抗性操縱，以及某些工具調用的不可逆後果可能導致有害的結果。<lb/>現有的安全措施要麼是事後用隨機LLM評判記錄的軌跡，要麼是逐一阻止不安全的行為，並且沒有單一的確定性工件支持這兩個角色。<lb/>我們提出了ContrAgent，一個基於合約的框架，用於LLM代理的符號時間監督。<lb/>ContrAgent將代理的行為捕捉為一系列工具調用，並將其形式化為一個固定可檢查謂詞集上的軌跡。<lb/>然後，它使用假設-保證合約在有限軌跡的線性時間邏輯（LTLf）中指定所需的行為。<lb/>每個合約被編譯為一個確定性有限自動機（DFA），該自動機擔任兩個角色：在線限制代理行為和離線評估記錄的軌跡。<lb/>合約庫作為可重用的知識庫，獨立於代理的模型維護，並可以應用於同一任務領域內的不同代理。<lb/>我們展示了我們的方法在四個基準測試中的有效性，這些基準測試涵蓋了這兩個角色，其中ContrAgent與最先進的LLM評判和基於規則的護欄基準相匹配，同時產生確定性、可重複的裁決，並且在在線模式下，每次調用的延遲降低了數個量級。
2609.18128.author: Yifeng Xiao et.al.
